name: @smileid/sample-apps-expo
description: Workspace root for the UseSmileID Expo sample app and its shared UI package.

pinRationale.@eslint/js: The flat-config base ruleset; matched to the eslint minor so the shared config keeps resolving.
pinRationale.eslint: Pinned exactly so a lint rule cannot appear between CI runs and red a lane nobody changed.
pinRationale.eslint-config-expo: Expo's own React Native flat config, which knows the Metro and JSX globals.
pinRationale.typescript-eslint: Type-aware linting for the two packages; pinned with eslint because the pair must agree.
